answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the reef graph. Re-attestations are stored in dune and sonnet lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 2 peers re-attest it every 7 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1670 impostors cost 1001 times the honest price and take 10 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
